summary: Four of six seats returned schema-valid reviews of the close bundle (claude, codex, kimi, glm); codex approved with no concern, the other three asked for revision. Qwen timed out and Gemini returned no JSON, so neither contributes an opinion. No concern has two supporters: the four concerns are divergent views, none rated above medium and none classed blocking by its reviewer. Three are about the close bundle's own text (claude twice, kimi once); one is about VG3's compatibility accounting for include roots without the mode (glm).
